revision_rule.note: The 2017 rule forbids output and ref arguments but does not also list inout arguments, which the 2023 expectation expressly forbids.
The 2012 standard does not specify the later guarantee that empty sequence matches cannot activate triggered or matched.
The 2012 formal tight-satisfaction definition supplies the corresponding zero-length sequence-match semantics rather than clause 16.7's later explicit match-point terminology.
IEEE 1800-2012 specifies zero repetition's empty-sequence semantics in 16.9.2.1 rather than in 16.12.22.
